modules.caption: 1-2 columns wide, short fixed height
modules.pull_quote: full-bleed horizontal box with accent frame
modules.gap: large negative space as conceptual pause

execution_rules: Use master pages for page numbers, section headers, margins, and grid.
Let selected images bleed under text blocks.
Use broken reading flow: paragraph, image interruption, resumed text.
Layer background image, base text, then labels and quotes.
Keep source and rights verification visible until final export.
